verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms an llms.txt at typesense.org/llms.txt (HTTP 200) that describes Typesense as a search engine 'for developers and AI agents', and a second index exists at /docs/llms.txt covering features and demos. The docs are also agent-friendly: pages offer 'Copy Markdown', .md page variants are served (e.g. mcp-server.md), and there is a 'Typesense for AI Agents' guide. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming these docs effectively, and consistent markdown endpoints (the probe of /docs/.md returned 404).
